about: The mutant ledger of scripts/tzdata, the writer of std tz/iana's zone copy runtime/tzdata/zones.bin (docs/spec/stdlib.md, tz 2). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./scripts/tzdata.

mutants.name: t2-tzdata-name-length-byte
mutants.rule: zones.bin is what Encode writes: each name after a big-endian uint16 length, as runtime/tzdata reads it.
